jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Global Media and Entertainment Security
jobs.description: Application deadline: Sep 29, 2026 We are changing the way millions of customers interact with entertainment that enriches lives. Amazon Global Media and Entertainment delivers experiences at unparalleled scale. Whether it's launching our own studio to create original and exclusive content or connecting players and developers to the games and communities they love, Amazon Global Media and Entertainment Security is at the center of customer, builder, and content journeys. Come build with us. We are building intelligent automation that is transforming how security reviews happen at scale. Our team has developed an AI-powered agent that lets builders run security assessments directly from their development environment, generating threat models, architecture diagrams, code review findings, and remediation guidance in minutes rather than weeks. Early adoption has already driven measurable impact, and you will help us in scaling this capability across Amazon. This is your chance to shape the future of security tooling and help developers ship secure software faster. This is a fast-paced, highly collaborative, startup-like environment inside Amazon. To be successful you need to be flexible, entrepreneurial, and comfortable operating with ambiguity. You are a true owner and you think backwards from the customer experience, are passionate about the potential customer impact, and operate at all levels. You will create new, innovative customer experiences from ideation to prototype to production, and shape the team roadmap with your innovations. Key job responsibilities • Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market. • You will be responsible for contributing to team by delivering code, helping set team's technical vision, architecture, and development practice • Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems. • You will be responsible for delivering key customer facing capabilities, delivering high-quality artifacts. • You will be responsible for raising the bar for the team's culture and helping grow the talent on the team. • You will work closely across product, customers and Security engineering to come up with new solutions for customers • Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software. A day in the life As a Software Development Engineer, you might start your morning in a design session with product and security engineering partners, translating a broadly defined customer problem into a technical architecture for a new capability. After lunch, you could be heads-down writing code for a key customer-facing feature, building scalable solutions that raise the quality bar for the team. Later in the day, you might pair with a teammate on a code review, share a new agent you have been exploring, or help refine the team's development practices. About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. Training & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Automated Reasoning Group
jobs.description: We are building the next generation of formally verified AI infrastructure in the Amazon Web Services (AWS), Neuron Automated Reasoning group. We are seeking a talented and passionate Software Development Engineer who wants to work at the intersection of programming language theory, formal verification, and cloud-scale service architecture. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will become an expert on Lean 4, a leading open-source functional programming language and interactive theorem prover. Lean is rapidly becoming the standard for formal verification, automated proof search, and high-assurance software development. You will help build a production AWS service that makes Lean accessible to customers who need mathematical guarantees but cannot afford the operational burden of managing theorem proving infrastructure themselves. Delivering a reliable, well-characterized, and scalable Lean service is foundational to our mission. This includes building the service infrastructure, integrating Lean into the Amazon build ecosystem, building orchestration intelligence, integration with building blocks like a conjecture store/solvers etc, and extending functionality for internal and external AWS customers. The engineering team will be fluent in the Lean language, its ecosystem, and its application to code correctness and proof automation. What does it take to thrive as a developer at Amazon? You are creative, responsible, and curious. You work with others to move quickly in turning ideas into customer solutions. You are excited about building systems that provide mathematical certainty in a world of probabilistic AI. You want the opportunity to grow your technical and professional skills while helping define a new category of cloud service. You relish the opportunity to dig into challenging problems at the boundary of programming languages, formal methods, and distributed systems. This role offers the opportunity to work alongside world-class technical and scientific leaders in automated reasoning, and to shape how formal verification becomes accessible at AWS scale. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.description: Overview Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. The Greenwood Cyber + AI Lab in Tulsa, Oklahoma is a Microsoft Security initiative focused on turning emerging cybersecurity and artificial intelligence challenges into applied research, experimentation, and real-world outcomes. Located in Tulsa’s historic Greenwood District and operating as part of the region’s federally designated Tech Hub, the Lab brings together Microsoft researchers and engineers with startups, industry, universities, community organizations, and public-sector stakeholders to accelerate cybersecurity and AI innovation, strengthen technical capability, and tackle consequential challenges that extend from the local ecosystem to national priorities. As a Security Research Engineer, you will be a hands-on technical contributor at the center of this work—helping scope high-value use cases, conduct security research, build and test prototypes and AI-enabled workflows, and move projects rapidly from problem definition to measurable results. You will also serve as an important technical bridge between the work happening in Greenwood and Microsoft Security, helping apply emerging capabilities in areas such as AI and agentic security to real-world scenarios while bringing insights from Lab experimentation back into Microsoft’s broader security research and engineering ecosystem. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Responsibilities We are looking for a hands-on Security Research Engineer who is excited to work at the intersection of cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and real-world experimentation. Based at Microsoft’s Greenwood Cyber + AI Lab in Tulsa, Oklahoma, you will w ork directly with Microsoft teams, startups, industry partners, universities, and community stakeholders to turn meaningful security challenges into focused technical research, experiments, prototypes, and measurable outcomes. This role offers a unique opportunity to conduct applied security research while helping build technical capability and innovation in Tulsa’s historic Greenwood District and connecting that work to Microsoft Security and broader Cyber + AI priorities. Responsibilities include: Conduct applied security research across emerging cybersecurity and AI challenges, including threat analysis, vulnerability research, security architecture, operational security, and the security implications and opportunities created by AI and agentic systems. Translate real-world challenges from startups, industry, academia, and other partners into well-defined technical use cases, research questions, success criteria, and executable experiments; contribute to focused, sprint-based engagements that move quickly from scoping through testing, findings, and tangible outcomes. Design, build, test, and iterate on technical prototypes, research environments, tools, automations, and AI-enabled security workflows using the Greenwood Cyber + AI Lab’s computing and security infrastructure, applying sound engineering, data-quality, privacy, and security practices throughout the research lifecycle. Identify security vulnerabilities, risks, attack paths, and potential mitigations through techniques such as threat modeling, architectural and design reviews, security testing, data analysis, and experimentation; document findings and collaborate with Microsoft and partner teams on appropriate remediation or solution approaches. Connect experimentation in Tulsa with Microsoft Security research, engineering, products, and emerging capabilities, helping translate relevant advances—including AI-enabled and agentic security technologies—into applied scenarios while bringing insights from real-world Lab engagements back into Microsoft. Contribute to the Greenwood Cyber + AI Lab’s place-based mission by collaborating with Tulsa-area startups, universities, industry, and community partners; sharing research and technical insights through demonstrations, workshops, publications, or other forums; and helping strengthen the region’s cybersecurity and AI innovation ecosystem while connecting Tulsa to broader national and global technology initiatives. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 1+ year(s) experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection. OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 2+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection. OR equivalent experience. Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. Preferred Qualifications: Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 3+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection. OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 5+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection. OR equivalent experience. Ability to work on-site at the Greenwood Cyber + AI Lab in Tulsa, Oklahoma, as required to support hands-on technical experimentation, Lab operations, and partner engagements. Experience conducting applied cybersecurity research or engineering in areas such as threat analysis, vulnerability research, threat modeling, security architecture, penetration testing, detection, attack disruption, or other offensive or defensive security disciplines. Experience developing or experimenting with artificial intelligence, machine learning, large language models, AI agents or agentic systems, automation, and/or AI-enabled cybersecurity workflows, including the ability to prototype and evaluate technical approaches using code and modern computing environments. Experience translating ambiguous real-world problems into technical experiments, prototypes, or solutions and collaborating across technical and non-technical stakeholders, such as engineering teams, customers, startups, universities, industry partners, or public-sector organizations, to drive projects toward measurable outcomes. Security Research IC3 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $102,100 - $202,200 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $133,800 - $219,200 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here: https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Amazon Leo Digital RF Systems
jobs.description: Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity. Join our mission to revolutionize space technology by developing secure, mission-critical software that powers our satellite constellation. Your work will directly enable communications, autonomous operations, and reliable performance for satellites serving customers worldwide—while ensuring robust security from the moment they launch until their planned de-orbit. About the Role: We're seeking an experienced embedded software engineer with security experience to architect and develop mission-critical firmware for our satellite systems. You'll work at the intersection of hardware and software, developing ASIC firmware including control for RF communication subsystems that enable high-performance satellite links. Your work will span secure ASIC boot operation, low-level register control, RF hardware configuration, algorithms and real-time embedded software that drives our satellite operations. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities * Lead software development for critical modules including ASIC firmware, command systems, telemetry processing, power control, hardware interfaces, and autonomous capabilities, implementing security-by-design principles throughout the satellite's operational lifetime * Design and implement robust software and firmware in Linux and real-time operating system (RTOS) environments, ensuring high reliability and security under resource constraints * Drive security architecture for the ASIC and involve in threat modeling by identifying potential vulnerabilities, conducting security reviews, and designing defensive measures to protect satellite systems from cyber threats * Build hardware interfaces by writing software that communicates with devices and electronics using protocols including I2C, I3C, SPI, UART, USB, JTAG, and Ethernet, with appropriate security controls and authentication mechanisms * Collaborate closely with hardware design teams, chip architects, and customers to support secure custom silicon chip and board design, bringing new hardware from concept through secure bring-up, verification, and integration * Champion reliability by following best practices in secure embedded software development, including secure coding standards, code reviews, and security testing to ensure our systems meet the demanding requirements of space operations * Optimize for production by partnering with test engineers to integrate security validation into manufacturing and test environments About the team * Meaningful impact: Your code will operate in space, enabling critical communications and services while protecting vital infrastructure * Technical growth: Work with exciting technology at the intersection of highly sophisticated ASIC/SOC, hardware, software, security, and space systems * Security leadership: Shape security practices and architecture for next-generation satellite systems * Collaborative environment: Partner with world-class hardware engineers, security architects, systems engineers, and domain experts * Innovation culture: We value creative problem-solving and encourage new approaches to complex security and engineering challenges - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field - Experience identifying bugs in architecture, algorithms, functionality, and performance with strong overall debugging skills - Experience verifying at multiple levels of logic from IP blocks to SoCs to full system testing - Master's degree in Electrical or Communications Engineering or a related field - Experience with formal verification techniques including abstraction and end-to-end checking - Experience with ARM and various DSP ISAs - Experience with current and upcoming RF standards in cellular (4G/5G NR), WiMAX, 802.11ad, microwave backhaul, or related broadband wireless standards - Experience with industry standard tools and scripting languages (Python or Perl) for automation Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
